name: Lolita Violence
original_name: ロリータバイオレンス
source:
One usual day from the life of one girl, but as she returns home late there are various dangers on her way back.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
少女原本平凡的一天，却因晚归而变了模样：回家路上，种种危险正等待着她。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1987.html]vndbreview[/url]]
